* '''Original''' (this page, 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Text: “Use 4 Force to deploy on table. During your draw phase, may stack a non-unique clone from your Lost Pile here face down. At the start of your turn, turn all cards here face up. You may deploy any face up card stacked here (as if from hand). [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics, and the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; same words.
